feed.title: RenX Takes Delivery of its Microtec Mill, a Step Toward Growing Media Made in Florida

feed.title: WisdomTree withdraws its Ethereum Trust S-1 registration filing

Both events highlight the evolving landscape and challenges within the cryptocurrency ETF market.

feed.title: What Does Align Technology (ALGN) Gain From Its Board Change?

This change introduces new operating and strategy experience aligned with Align Technology's focus on digital workflow investments and manufacturing expansion. The move is expected to support governance continuity and will be evaluated by how the company executes its digital and manufacturing programs through 2027.

feed.title: Sempra files for permits to add 27 mtpa LNG expansion at Port Arthur, Texas
feed.summary: Sempra has filed for permits for its Port Arthur LNG North Project in Texas, an expansion aiming to add four liquefaction trains with a combined capacity of up to 27 million metric tons per annum (mtpa) of LNG. This project, which also includes three storage tanks and marine facilities, would significantly increase Sempra's total Port Arthur capacity to around 53 mtpa, making it one of the largest LNG export operations globally. The North Project, if approved and constructed on schedule, is estimated to begin exporting LNG in the second half of 2034, further solidifying Southeast Texas's role as a global LNG export hub.

feed.title: Verizon Waives Charges for Hurricane Lowell, Prepares Network in Hawai'i
feed.summary: Verizon is waiving domestic call, text, and data charges for customers on Kaua’i through September 14 due to Major Hurricane Lowell. The company has also reinforced its network infrastructure in Hawai'i with backup generators, satellite assets, and pre-staged equipment, and is collaborating with emergency management to ensure connectivity. Verizon is urging residents and businesses to take digital preparedness steps, such as charging devices, securing backups, and establishing communication plans.

feed.title: Uber and city near Mount Fuji join hands in measures against overtourism
feed.summary: Uber's Japanese unit has partnered with Fujiyoshida city near Mount Fuji to combat overtourism issues like traffic congestion and littering. This first-of-its-kind agreement with a Japanese municipality will involve Uber setting up designated pickup spots away from crowded areas and using its app to inform tourists about local customs and etiquette. The initiative aims to balance tourism growth with the well-being of local residents.

feed.title: Maryland bills could rise 5.3% under a Potomac Edison plan. Rates would still be lowest among investor-owned utilities.
feed.summary: Potomac Edison has proposed a $52.8 million rate adjustment in Maryland to fund upgrades to its electric system, which would result in an average residential customer bill increase of about 5.3%. Despite this potential increase, the company asserts that its residential rates would remain the lowest among Maryland's investor-owned utilities, being 25% below the in-state peer average as of June 1. The proposal, which aims to strengthen reliability through grid modernization, infrastructure improvements, and expanded tree-clearing, requires review and approval by the Maryland Public Service Commission.

The move reinforces Aptiv's strategy to expand into higher-margin, non-automotive AI systems and diversify its revenue streams.

feed.title: Altria's PM Deal Can Strengthen Efficiency of Its Tobacco Business

feed.title: Tampa Defense Firm Joins NYSE After $110M Raise
feed.summary: Tampa-headquartered XTEND AI Robotics, trading as “XTND” on the NYSE, has completed a merger that raised $110 million to expand its manufacturing capabilities. The company, which specializes in robotics for defense, law enforcement, and security, merged with JFB Construction Holdings and is now well-capitalized to scale its AI-powered robotics platform globally. XTEND has already deployed over 12,500 systems in more than 30 countries and five combat zones and recently extended its XOS to ground robotics.

feed.title: Freedom Broker Turns Bullish on Argan (AGX) After Record Quarter

Despite strong performance and a $2.5 billion project backlog, the company faces near-term challenges including a potential revenue slowdown in Q3 and lower-than-expected gross margins in the Industrial segment due to cost overruns.

feed.title: The Bull Case For HCA Healthcare (HCA) Could Change Following 2026 Guidance Cut And Payer Mix Strain
feed.summary: HCA Healthcare recently cut its full-year 2026 earnings guidance due to a worsening payer mix, softer elective surgeries, and rising costs, leading to layoffs and a hospital divestiture. This guidance cut, alongside an estimated $400 million quarterly revenue impact from payer shifts, challenges the previously optimistic investment narrative for HCA. Investors need to assess how these pressures and policy-driven reimbursement changes will impact the company's profitability and long-term financial health.

feed.title: Boycott of Starbucks Is Still On as Workers Press for $17 Wage and Protections
feed.summary: Starbucks Workers United is continuing its boycott of the coffee giant this Labor Day weekend, demanding a minimum hourly wage of $17, improved staffing, and better workplace protections. This ongoing action follows a recent victory where Starbucks stopped using a silica-based powder in its drinks due to worker complaints. The union faces challenges from a Republican-majority National Labor Relations Board, which has overturned several pro-union rulings.

feed.title: Health insurer Anthem targeted in lawsuit over air ambulance claims
feed.summary: PHI Health LLC is suing Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield for approximately $30 million in unpaid air ambulance claims. The lawsuit alleges that Anthem is ignoring binding arbitration awards under the federal No Surprises Act, failing to pay over 1,200 final determinations. PHI Health seeks judicial enforcement of these determinations and over $1.3 million in interest.

feed.title: Thunderstorms in Greensboro knock out power to 31,000 Duke Energy customers
feed.summary: Thunderstorms in Greensboro caused widespread power outages for 31,000 Duke Energy customers on Friday. The storms also brought down 77 trees across the city and damaged several city parks and facilities.

feed.title: Adobe Inc. (ADBE) Acquires Rilo to Accelerate Agentic AI — What It Means for Investors
feed.summary: Adobe Inc. (ADBE) has acquired Rilo, an India-based AI workflow automation startup, to enhance its agentic AI capabilities and expand its marketing intelligence. This acquisition aims to integrate Rilo's AI agents, which automate complex marketing workflows, into Adobe's existing products, thereby strengthening its position against tech giants investing heavily in AI marketing. While Rilo could bolster Adobe's enterprise offerings, investors are keen to see how this translates into accelerated revenue growth and improved monetization amidst ongoing competition and concerns about AI's impact on its core creative software.
